messages.content:
Issues:
1. [major LOGIC] at T2 -> T6: Step T6 (writing unit tests) depends only on 'design', but the tests require the implementation of the logic (spot assignment and fee calculation) which is created in T2. (fix: Add T2 as a dependency for T6 so that the tests can be written against the implemented code.)

Requirements:
R1 [must] Identify the actors that interact with the garage system.
R2 [must] For each actor, describe at least two goals in one sentence each.
R3 [must] The domain model must cover levels and parking spots of different sizes.
R4 [must] The domain model must cover vehicles and their size classes.
R5 [must] The domain model must cover tickets with entry and exit times.
R6 [must] The domain model must cover payments for a ticket.
R7 [must] Implement the domain model in an object‑oriented language of your choice.
R8 [must] Assign the smallest free spot that fits a vehicle.
R9 [must] Issue a ticket when a vehicle enters.
R10 [must] Calculate the fee from the entry and exit times.
R11 [must] Free the spot when the vehicle leaves.
R12 [should] The fee rules should be easy to change without editing the ticket class.
R13 [should] The command‑line interface must support parking a vehicle.
R14 [should] The command‑line interface must support removing a vehicle and printing its fee.
R15 [should] The command‑line interface must support showing the free spots on each level.
R16 [must] Write unit tests for the spot assignment and the fee calculation.

Plan steps:
research [research] Research the approach (requirements: -; after: -) criteria: every research question has an answer with sources; the answers name the options considered
verify [research] Check the research findings (requirements: -; after: research) criteria: every claim the design uses is supported by a source; unsupported claims are marked
design [design] Design the solution (requirements: -; after: verify) criteria: each part has a module and an interface; the skeleton runs; the design follows the constraints; C2 respected: Use only the standard library of your language.
T1 [implement] Design domain model classes (requirements: R3, R4, R5, R6; after: design) criteria: Domain model includes levels and parking spots of different sizes (R3); Domain model includes vehicles and their size classes (R4); Domain model includes tickets with entry and exit times (R5); Domain model includes payments for a ticket (R6)
T6 [implement] Write unit tests for spot assignment and fee calculation (requirements: R16; after: design) criteria: unit tests cover spot assignment logic; unit tests cover fee calculation logic
T8 [implement] Implement: Identify the actors that interact with the gara… (requirements: R1; after: design) criteria: R1: Identify the actors that interact with the garage system.
T2 [implement] Implement domain model and core logic (requirements: R7, R8, R9, R10, R11, R12; after: T1) criteria: Domain model is implemented in an OO language (R7); System assigns the smallest free spot that fits a vehicle (R8); System issues a ticket when a vehicle enters (R9); System calculates the fee from entry and exit times (R10)
T10 [implement] Implement: For each actor, describe at least two goals in… (requirements: R2; after: T8) criteria: R2: For each actor, describe at least two goals in one sentence each.
T7 [test] Run unit tests and ensure they pass (requirements: R16; after: T6) criteria: all unit tests pass; no unexpected exceptions are raised during test execution
T9 [test] Check: Identify the actors that interact with the garage… (requirements: R1; after: T8) criteria: R1 works as stated
T11 [test] Check: For each actor, describe at least two goals in on… (requirements: R2; after: T10) criteria: R2 works as stated
T3 [implement] Implement command‑line interface (requirements: R13, R14, R15; after: T2) criteria: CLI supports parking a vehicle (R13); CLI supports removing a vehicle and printing its fee (R14); CLI supports showing the free spots on each level (R15)
T4 [test] Write unit tests for core logic (requirements: R8, R9, R10, R11, R12; after: T2) criteria: Test confirms the smallest suitable spot is assigned (R8); Test confirms a ticket is created on vehicle entry (R9); Test confirms fee is correctly calculated from times (R10); Test confirms the spot becomes free after vehicle leaves (R11)
T5 [test] Write integration tests for CLI (requirements: R13, R14, R15; after: T3) criteria: CLI test parks a vehicle and reports success (R13); CLI test removes a vehicle and prints the correct fee (R14); CLI test lists free spots per level accurately (R15)
T12 [document] Prepare class diagram (requirements: -; after: T4, T5, T7, T9, T11) criteria: D2 exists: class diagram as PDF; it matches the finished, tested work
review [review] Final review (requirements: -; after: T12) criteria: every must requirement is met; every deliverable is present; C1 respected: Discuss your ideas with your lab partner, sketch them on paper first, and only then move on to the computer.; C2 respected: Use only the standard library of your language.
